caption: The drawing depicts a side view of a horse in mid-stride, shown in a prancing or running pose with its tail and mane flowing backward. The horse is rendered in shades of gray, with detailed shading to suggest muscles and contours on its body. The horse stands on a horizontal bar, which is supported by a vertical rod that attaches to the ground and is further stabilized by a round base directly beneath the body. The entire composition is contained within a rectangular border with the artist’s name "ISIDORE SOVENSKY" inscribed in small capital letters in the lower right corner. In the lower left corner, there is a small horizontal ruler marked from 0' to 5'. The background of the drawing is plain and unadorned, with the primary focus on the horse and its supporting structure.
title: Weather Vane Finial
